items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes. They had played football here that day. >> [INTERVIEWEE] O'Brian.

ctx.x: Yes. They had played football here that day.

But I begged Zutty to quit because I could see it coming on. And he knows, I told him two or three times. Say you're bringing your blood pressure up. I'm saying it facetiously but I'd tell him. I'd say listen Zutty we'll live on your pension and our social security. We can get social security. I was getting my social security. And we'll just live on that. Who needs it? And we'd go on and he'd say, well you know Mattas wanting me in there so badly.
